tabs.html:
Brother PT-E115B Label Printer

he Brother PT-E115B is a compact, handheld label printer designed for professionals requiring durable and legible labels in various environments. Whether you're labeling cables, panels, or equipment, this device offers reliability and ease of use.

Key Specifications

  • Display: 15-character x 1-line LCD screen
  • Keyboard: QWERTY layout for efficient typing
  • Compatible Tape Sizes: 3.5mm, 6mm, 9mm, 12mm
  • Tape Types: Standard Laminated, Flexible ID, Extra Strength Adhesive, Non-Laminated Iron-on Fabric, Acid-Free
  • Print Resolution: 180 dpi
  • Print Speed: Up to 20mm per second
  • Power Options: 6 AA batteries or optional AC adapter
  • Cutter: Manual
  • Dimensions: Approximately 4.3" W x 8.0" H x 2.2" D
  • Weight: Approximately 0.7 kg​

Features

  • Multiple Fonts and Styles: Choose from 3 fonts (Helsinki, Brussels, US) and 10 styles including Normal, Bold, Outline, Shadow, Italic, and more.
  • Font Sizes: Options include Small, Medium, and Large to suit various labeling needs.
  • Built-in Symbols: Access to 253 symbols for enhanced label customization.
  • Vertical Printing: Supports vertical label printing for specific applications.
  • Auto Numbering: Automatically increments numbers from 1 to 10 on labels.
  • Memory Function: Stores up to 15 label designs for quick reuse.
  • Label Length Setting: Adjustable label length settings for precise labeling.
  • Multi-copy Printing: Print up to 9 copies of the same label.
  • Date/Time Stamp: Option to include date and time on labels.
  • Built-in Designs/Templates: Offers 17 Deco Mode Patterns and 9 Auto Designs for creative labeling.​

The PT-E115B is well-suited for:

Electrical Installations: Labeling wires, panels, and circuits.

Network Cabling: Organizing and identifying network cables.

Industrial Maintenance: Marking equipment and machinery.

Office Organization: Labeling files, folders, and storage areas.
